verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only indirect paths to getting data out. Payment and receipt data can be retrieved through the Stripe API, webhooks push real-time event data to your own endpoint, and an OpenAPI spec, CLI and MCP server allow programmatic access. Nothing documents a dedicated bulk export, open file formats such as CSV or JSON dumps, or an account-exit or migration path. Missing for 10: documented bulk data export, explicit open-format export (CSV/JSON), data portability or offboarding guidance, and independent corroboration of exporting Terminal data.
